# VI LOGIX Shipment Tracking

> Public shipment status lookup for VI LOGIX orders.

Enter a VI LOGIX tracking number to open an approved embedded tracking view. Invalid, malformed and unapproved numbers do not load the carrier website.

## Public pages

- [Track Your Shipment | VI LOGIX](https://track.vilogx.co/): Enter your tracking number to view the latest shipment updates.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://track.vilogx.co/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://track.vilogx.co/robots.txt)
